method: Five fixed nearest-surface barycentric landmarks on base skin, same seed offsets from version-specific poll and withers. Head is poll to upper lip surface point. Top line is a 33-point sagittal upper-surface polyline; lower line is throatlatch to neck-shoulder junction chord, explicitly not a traced underside arc. Added mane/face relief excluded. World pitch uses evaluated skin head direction and anatomical Spine_0 to Spine_7 trunk axis. Rest and source metadata included for audit; this measurement is not an anatomical ground truth.
target_note: Requested head/top ~= 2/3 is a conformation guide, not met exactly. v7 Stand measured 0.762 (top/head 1.312) and top/lower chord 2.044. Do not claim exact 2:3 compliance. Visual judgment is based on the declared PD stallion and motion photographs plus independent review.
units: meters at reference scale 2.6; angles are world-space degrees
